displayName: Azure AI resources should have a required governance tag
description: Audit or deny core Azure AI resources when a selected tag is absent or empty. Assign separately for each required tag. This does not validate the tag's accuracy. Audit is the default; Deny requires explicit selection.

metadata.description: Audit reports noncompliance by default. Deny blocks noncompliant create or update requests when explicitly selected.
Target parent resource types that support tags. Extend deliberately for supporting services.
Use ai-workload to group an AI solution and its supporting resources. Its value is a nonempty workload identifier, such as support-chatbot.
